messages:
Mike: Heads-up — ran into a rollout scenario where we want an automatic "rollback fuse" that pauses a config rollout when error rate spikes. Can we add a dashboard card + an approval nudge to owners? :eyes:
Sarah: +1. Console currently alerts but doesn't give a clear next-action. We need an API hook to pause and surface the reason + snapshot of recent telemetry to the owners.
Raj: what's the exact API surface you want? We already have POST /rollouts/:id/pause used manually.
Jen: POST /rollouts/:id/pause exists but it's manual and requires auth. If telemetry triggers it we need idempotency and a "trigger=telemetry" tag so we don't clobber manual pauses.
Mike: proposal: auto-pause flow -> telemetry detects spike -> call internal webhook -> PATCH /rollouts/:id/state {state:"paused",source:"telemetry",reason:"5xx_rate>2%_5m"} with idempotency token. Include a short telemetry snapshot in the body.
Raj: ok. Make it PATCH and include precondition header like If-Match: rollout-etag to avoid racy transitions. Also a small TTL for the auto-pause token so a later manual resume isn't overwritten by a stale webhook.
Jen: agree on If-Match. Also require a signed service token from telemetry pipeline to call the API (no anonymous webhooks).
deploy-bot: (system) Auto-pause executed: rollout r-847 paused due to 5xx_rate=2.6% over 5m. Notifying owners: @Sarah @Raj @Jess
Sarah: nice. We should add a lightweight nudge card in the console that shows: reason, last 5m chart, top 3 impacted routes, and two buttons: "Resume (safely)" and "Request rollback".
Jess: can we avoid spamming owners during noisy infra blips? Maybe only nudge if spike persists after 2 sampling windows or if error budget consumption crosses threshold.
Raj: yes — define policy: require 2 consecutive windows (configurable; default 2), or single-window if absolute spike > 5%. Also backoff notifications per rollout (exponential, capped) so owners don't get pinged every minute.
Mike: telemetry team: need a shape for the webhook payload. Suggest this snippet for the body (we'll send as a code block in the notif):
```
{
  "rollout_id": "r-847",
  "metric": "5xx_rate",
  "value": 0.026,
  "window_secs": 300,
  "trigger_count": 2,
  "snapshot": {
    "top_routes": ["/v1/generate","/v1/chat"],
    "last5m_p50_p95": [120, 450]
  }
}
```
Jen: fine but snapshot should be small — compress top_routes to at most 10 and truncate strings. Also avoid including raw keys/tokens.
Ops-bot: (system) Added alert rule draft: "rollout-telemetry-fuse" in prod namespace. Preview link: https://console.internal/alerts/rollout-telemetry-fuse
Mike: console UX notes: add a "Pending Fuse Actions" overview in the rollouts table and a toast-style nudge for owners with a single-click link to a prefilled incident page. Also surface who can approve safe resume (team ownership / SLAs).
Sarah: telemetry gating: we should include a sampling flag for low-traffic cohorts so a 2% spike on 50 requests doesn't trigger. Recommend absolute-min-requests threshold (default 200 requests / window).
Raj: implementation plan: 1) Jess prototypes webhook consumer + idempotent PATCH with If-Match (ETA 2d) 2) Mike adds console card + nudge UI (ETA 4d) 3) telemetry tunes and wires webhook + rate/backoff config (ETA 3d) 4) ops reviews alert rule and notifiers (ETA 1d).
Jess: I'll prototype and push a PR: internal API change + small e2e. Will add integration tests for the If-Match race and token auth.
Mike: thanks. owners assigned: @Sarah (svc owner), @Raj (runtime), @Jess (implementer). If no reply in 30m after auto-pause, send escalation to oncall.
Sarah: noted. please add docs to the rollout runbook (how to inspect snapshot, resume safely, and rollback playbook). :+1:
Mike: logging housekeeping: put a compact event in the audit log for every auto-pause with fields: rollout_id, trigger, snapshot_ref. Keep payloads as refs to blobstore to avoid huge logs.
Jen: security check: ensure the webhook consumer validates token signature and rate-limits the incoming calls.
Ops-bot: (system) Thread recorded to runbook draft: https://docs.internal/runbooks/rollout-fuse
Mike: ok closing loop — will file the work items and update this thread when PRs are up.
